cues.en: The kilogram is in trouble. Since 1799,
cues.zh: 千克遇到麻烦了。自1799年以来，

cues.en: it's been defined as the mass of a metal cylinder in a locked vault in a basement in Paris. But over the last century, careful measurements of this international prototype kilogram and in theory identical national standards from around the world have shown that their masses are diverging.
cues.zh: 它一直被定义为巴黎某处地下室里一个上锁保险库中金属圆柱体的质量。但在过去一个世纪里，对这个国际千克原器以及世界各地理论上完全相同的国家基准所做的精密测量显示，它们的质量正在逐渐分化。

cues.en: The spread has grown to around 50 micrograms or 50 parts per billion and having a standard of mass that changes is unacceptable.
cues.zh: 质量标准的偏差已增大到约50微克，也就是十亿分之五十，而质量标准会变化是不可接受的。

cues.en: Plus, the kilogram is the last of the base SI units to still be defined by a physical object.
cues.zh: 此外，千克是最后一个仍由实物定义的国际单位制基本单位。

cues.en: The meter, for example, used to be defined as the length of a platinum bar in Paris, but in 1983,
cues.zh: 例如，米过去被定义为巴黎一根铂棒的长度，但在1983年，

cues.en: it was redefined as the distance light travels in one over two nine nine seven nine two four five eights of a second. This definition means that the speed of light is set to exactly two nine nine seven nine two four five eight point zero zero zero zero zero, etcetera, meters per second.
cues.zh: 它被重新定义为光在1/299792458秒内传播的距离。这个定义意味着光速被精确设定为299792458.00000……米每秒。

cues.en: Note how this works. First, you take the existing definition, say the length of that meter bar, and you measure as carefully as you can how it relates to a physical constant of universe, the speed of light. Then you set the exact value of that constant and use it to redefine how long a meter is.
cues.zh: 注意这是怎么运作的。首先，你拿现有的定义，比如那根米尺的长度，尽可能仔细地测量它与宇宙中一个物理常数——光速——之间的关系。然后你设定该常数的精确值，并用它重新定义一米有多长。

cues.en: I know this might seem circular,
cues.zh: 我知道这看起来可能有点循环论证，

cues.en: but importantly, it moves the point of truth off of the physical object and onto the unchanging
cues.zh: 但重要的是，它把真值的锚点从物理对象转移到了不变的

cues.en: constant of the universe.
cues.zh: 宇宙常数上。

cues.en: So naturally, the thought is to do the same thing with the kilogram,
cues.zh: 于是很自然地，大家想到对千克做同样的事，

cues.en: but using which constant and how?
cues.zh: 但用哪个常数，又该怎么用呢？

I mean, you can use Avogadro's

cues.zh: 数来计算普朗克常数，反之亦然。所以最终两种方法都会被用来重新定义普朗克常数和阿伏伽德罗

cues.en: here I wanna focus on the watt balance. It's actually now called a kibble balance balance in honor of its inventor Brian Kibble who actually passed away in 2016.
cues.zh: 这次我想重点讲瓦特天平。它现在其实叫基布尔天平，是为了纪念它的发明者布莱恩·基布尔，他在2016年去世了。

cues.en: You know, traditional balances work by equating the gravitational forces on objects in two pans.
cues.zh: 你知道，传统天平是通过让两个秤盘里物体所受的重力相等来工作的。

cues.en: The kibble balance looks kinda similar but all of the balancing happens on the left hand side where a mass pan is attached to a coil of wire in a magnetic field. On the right hand side is a motor.
cues.zh: 基布尔天平看起来有点像，但所有平衡过程都在左侧完成：质量秤盘连接着磁场中的线圈。右侧则是一台电机。

cues.en: The whole apparatus is sealed and operated in vacuum. The balance operates in two modes weighing mode and velocity mode and both are required to determine Planck's constant.
cues.zh: 整个装置是密封的，并在真空中运行。天平以两种模式工作：称重模式和速度模式，两者都是测定普朗克常数所必需的。

cues.en: In weighing mode, a kilogram mass standard is placed on the mass pan and then current is passed through the coil in the magnetic field and adjusted until the weight of the kilogram is equal and opposite to the electromagnetic force on the coil.
cues.zh: 在称量模式下，把一个千克标准砝码放到砝码盘上，然后让电流通过磁场中的线圈，并调节电流，直到该千克砝码的重量与线圈受到的电磁力大小相等、方向相反。

cues.en: The equation for this is mass times the local gravitational acceleration
cues.zh: 其方程为：质量乘以当地重力加速度

cues.en: is equal to the magnetic field times the length of wire in the coil times the current flowing through it. In this equation, the variables that are difficult to measure exactly are the magnetic field strength and the length of wire in the coil. But luckily the kibble balance allows us to get around this problem using velocity mode. In velocity mode, the kilogram mass is lifted off the mass pan and now the motor on the other side of the balance is used to move the coil back and forth at constant velocity through magnetic field.
cues.zh: 等于磁感应强度乘以线圈中导线的长度，再乘以流过线圈的电流。在这个方程中，难以精确测量的变量是磁感应强度和线圈中导线的长度。但幸运的是，基布尔天平能让我们用速度模式绕开这个问题。在速度模式下，把千克砝码从砝码盘上抬起，然后利用天平另一侧的电机，让线圈在磁场中以恒定速度来回移动。

cues.en: This motion induces a voltage in the coil which is equal to the magnetic field times the length of wire in the coil times its velocity.
cues.zh: 这种运动会在���圈中感应出电压，等于磁场强度 × 线圈导线长度 × 其速度。

cues.en: Now we have two equations which we can solve for b times l and so we can set them equal to each other and eliminate these variables without having to know precisely what their values are. And if we rearrange a little bit you get voltage times current equals mass times gravity times velocity.
cues.zh: 现在有两个方程，可以解出 b 乘 l，于是能把它们设为相等，消去这些变量，而不必精确知道它们的值。再稍作整理，就得到电压 × 电流等于质量 × 重力加速度 × 速度。

cues.en: On the left hand side, there is electrical power and on the right hand side mechanical power and that's why this was called the watt, the unit of power balance.
cues.zh: 左边是电功率，右边是机械功率，这就是为什么它被称为瓦特，功率平衡的单位。

cues.en: But how do you go from this to Planck's constant, the number that relates a photon's frequency to its energy?
cues.zh: 但你怎么从这里过渡到普朗克常数——那个把光子频率和能量联系起来的数？

cues.en: Well, turns out there's actually a way of measuring voltage accurately using a macroscopic
cues.zh: 嗯，其实有一种方法可以准确测量电压，利用宏观的

cues.en: quantum effect that involves Josephson junctions.
cues.zh: 量子效应，涉及约瑟夫森结。

cues.en: So a Josephson junction consists of two superconductors separated by a thin piece of insulator.
cues.zh: 约瑟夫森结由两个超导体组成，中间隔着一层薄绝缘体。

cues.en: Now if you apply a microwave radiation
cues.zh: 现在，如果你施加微波辐射

cues.en: to that junction, you create a voltage across the device and its value is precisely known to be hf over two e where h is Planck's constant, f is the frequency of the radiation and e is the charge on an electron.
cues.zh: 到该结上，就会在器件两端产生电压，其数值精确等于 hf 除以 2e，其中 h 是普朗克常数，f 是辐射频率，e 是电子电荷。

cues.en: Now by tuning that frequency and stacking as many of these Josephson junctions as you want in series,
cues.zh: 现在，通过调节该频率，并把任意多个这种约瑟夫森结串联起来，

cues.en: you can create virtually any voltage you like very very precisely. The way this is used in the kibble balance is a stack of hundreds of thousands of Josephson junctions are put into the circuit with the coil as it is moved through the field. And so you exactly balance the voltage which is induced in the coil using those Josephson junctions. So you can measure that voltage very very accurately. But how do we measure current?
cues.zh: 你就能非常非常精确地产生几乎任意想要的电压。它在 Kibble 天平中的用法是：把由数十万个约瑟夫森结组成的堆栈与线圈一起接入电路，线圈则在磁场中移动。这样，你就用这些约瑟夫森结精确平衡线圈中感应出的电压。于是你就能非常非常准确地测量该电压。但电流又该怎么测量呢？

cues.en: Well, turns out this voltage measuring method is so good that instead of trying to measure current directly, we instead measure V on R which is the same thing. So this current is passed through a resistor and we measure that voltage again using Joseph's injunctions. And then to measure resistance, we use another macroscopic quantum effect called the quantum hall effect, which is beyond the scope of this video. But suffice it to say that the resistance measurement will be an integer fraction one over p times Planck's constant divided by the charge on the electron squared.
cues.zh: 结果发现，这种测电压的方法太好用了，所以我们不再直接测电流，而是测电阻 R 两端的电压 V，效果完全一样。因此，让电流通过一个电阻，再用约瑟夫森结测量这个电压。至于测电阻，我们利用另一种宏观量子效应，叫量子霍尔效应，这超出了本视频的范围。但可以简单说，电阻测量值会是 1/p 乘以普朗克常数除以电子电荷的平方。

cues.en: So if we sub all of this into our equation and solve for h, we have that Planck's constant is equal to four over p n squared. Those are all constant numbers that we know, times the local acceleration due to gravity, times velocity,
cues.zh: 把这些都代入方程并解出 h，就得到普朗克常数等于 4 除以 pn 的平方。这些都是我们已知的常数，再乘以当地重力加速度，再乘以速度，

cues.en: divided by frequency squared, times the mass, which is one kilogram. So here we have a very precise
cues.zh: 再除以频率的平方，乘以质量，也就是一千克。这样我们就得到了一个非常精确的

cues.en: equation for Planck's constant in terms of the mass of one kilogram. Now to get an answer that's good to say 10 parts per billion, you need to know all of these values very accurately.
cues.zh: 用一千克的质量来表示普朗克常数的方程。而要得到精确到十亿分之十左右的答案，你需要非常准确地知道所有这些值。

cues.en: So to measure v for example, the velocity of the coil as it moves through the magnetic field, we use a laser interferometer.
cues.zh: 比如要测量 v，也就是线圈在磁场中运动时的速度，我们会使用激光干涉仪。

cues.en: As the distance to the coil changes, the interference fringes pass over a detector and essentially by counting how many fringes go past in a certain period of time, you can determine the speed of the coil very accurately.
cues.zh: 当到线圈的距离变化时，干涉条纹会掠过探测器；本质上，只要统计一定时间内有多少条纹经过，就能非常准确地确定线圈的速度。

cues.en: To measure g, a device called a gravimeter was used to map out the local acceleration due to gravity in the balance room before it was built in there. The gravimeter actually drops a corner reflector down a vacuum tube and measures its acceleration again through interferometry counting the fringes as they pass.
cues.zh: 为了测量 g，在平衡装置安装到那里之前，人们用一台叫重力仪的装置测出了天平室里当地的重力加速度分布。重力仪实际上会让一个角反射器沿真空管下落，并再次通过干涉测量、统计经过的条纹来测出它的加速度。

cues.en: This is a three d printed map of the acceleration due to gravity in the kibble balance room. The bump is due to the mass of the powerful and very heavy permanent magnet that's in the balance.
cues.zh: 这是一张3D打印的基布尔天平房间内重力加速度分布图。这个凸起是由天平中那块强力且非常重的永磁体的质量造成的。

cues.en: The acceleration due to gravity must continually be measured because it can be affected at this level of precision by the positions of the sun and moon and even the water table underneath the building. In 2018, the kilogram will no longer be defined by an object in Paris.
cues.zh: 必须持续测量重力加速度，因为在这种精度下，它会受到太阳和月亮位置的影响，甚至受到建筑下方地下水位的影响。2018年，千克将不再由一个巴黎的物体来定义。

cues.en: Instead, it will be defined based on the fixed value of Planck's constant, which is being finalized right now as a result of all these measurements from the kibble balances and silicon spheres. So right now, what we do is we put the mass in and we get h out.
cues.zh: 相反，它将根据普朗克常数的固定值来定义；这个固定值目前正基于基布尔天平和硅球的所有测量结果最终确定。所以现在我们的做法是：把质量放进去，得到 h。
